item.description: Maine Senate candidate Graham Platner claims that he competed against women in high school wrestling decades ago and "nobody cared," therefore men in women's sports is a non-issue.

item.title: Las Vegas Raiders Were Absolutely Keeping Maxx Crosby — Until They Didn't, And Now He's A Baltimore Raven
item.description: Baltimore Ravens acquire Maxx Crosby from Las Vegas Raiders for two first-round picks including No. 14 overall in 2026 draft, nearly matching the Micah Parsons trade price.

item.title: Aaron Judge Homer Powers Team USA To Dominant Win Over Brazil, Despite Shaky Pitching Performances
